rationale: The plan identifies the condition-by-time interaction correctly and uses the DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, explicitly justifying the LRT over a single Wald coefficient because four time points give three interaction coefficients, and it follows with per-time-point simple effects and trajectory clustering exactly as the reference expects. QC on blind VST (PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, colored by condition and shaped by time, replicate-cell tabulation, flag-not-drop policy) precedes any modeling; the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, justified as the smallest cell size) is minimal and stated with before/after gene counts; median-of-ratios normalization stays inside the model with an explicit prohibition on pre-scaling. BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, Cook's outlier NAs reported separately, and apeglm/ashr shrinkage named per contrast with ranking on shrunken values are all specified. Enrichment is preranked fgsea on the full tested list with a stated universe, size window, seed, collapse, and named collections with versions; the signed-LRT ranking is a defensible if slightly awkward construction, and enrichment is arguably optional here, so it loses a point rather than being penalized. The report step names method, versions, design, reference levels, thresholds, tested/significant counts, diagnostics, reproducibility record, and an explicit n=3 interaction-power caveat, with the honest note that only one test framework was run.
